purpose: FHA mortgage insurance premium (MIP) eligibility and cost calculator per HUD Handbook 4000.1. UFMIP: 1.75% of base loan. Annual MIP grid (0.15%-0.75%) by base loan amount vs $726,200 threshold, LTV, and term. MIP duration: 11 years when original LTV at or below 90%; life-of-loan when above 90%. Qualifying ratios: 31% front-end / 43% back-end (compensating factors to 40%/57%). Credit score floors: 580 for 96.5% LTV; 500-579 for 90% max. Table version: HUD-MIP-ML2023-05-ML2024-01 (HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05, effective 2023-03-20).
